topic.label: Electrical Engineering
topic.desc: Electrical Engineering: circuits, electronics, signals, electromagnetics, power and control, from device physics to systems.

concepts: Applying Kirchhoff laws and network theorems to find voltages, currents and transient and frequency responses of linear circuits.
Semiconductor devices and amplifier, filter and converter circuits built from diodes, transistors and op-amps.
Boolean logic, sequential circuits, hardware description languages, FPGAs and microcontrollers.
Representing and processing signals in time and frequency, and transmitting information over channels.
Static and dynamic electric and magnetic fields, transmission lines, waves and antennas.
Power Systems, Power Electronics and Control
Generating, converting and distributing electrical energy and controlling dynamic systems with feedback.
skills: Solves linear circuits with nodal and mesh analysis and checks results with power balance and simulation.
Computes RC, RL and RLC transient responses and checks time constants and initial and final values.
Analyses sinusoidal steady state with phasors and impedance and checks magnitude and phase against simulation.
Designs transistor and op-amp amplifier stages to a gain and bandwidth spec and checks bias points and stability.
Designs active filters to a frequency response and checks cutoff, ripple and component tolerances.
Explains and models diode and MOSFET behavior from device physics and checks against datasheet curves.
Minimizes Boolean functions and builds gate-level circuits and checks equivalence with truth tables.
Writes synthesizable Verilog modules and checks behavior with testbenches and timing reports.
Writes microcontroller firmware for peripherals and checks timing and interrupts on hardware traces.
Computes Fourier transforms and spectra of signals and checks aliasing and windowing effects.
Designs FIR and IIR digital filters and checks frequency response, phase and stability.
Computes link budgets, modulation choice and bit error rates and checks margin against channel noise.
Analyses transmission lines and designs impedance matching networks and checks reflection on a Smith chart.
Estimates antenna gain, pattern and impedance and checks against field simulation results.
Solves power flow in a network and checks bus voltages and line loadings against limits.
Designs buck, boost and inverter stages and checks efficiency, ripple and thermal limits.
Tunes feedback controllers for a plant model and checks overshoot, settling time and stability margins.
mcp: Inject precise, real-time computation and knowledge
Model Context Protocol server for symbolic mathematics and computer algebra built on SymPy
Fast search and full-text access over arXiv pre-prints
